raw_text:
Fathima Beevi 
Customer Support Team Lead 
Malappuram, Kerala  |  fathima.beevi@example.com  |  91880XXXXX 
Summary 
Customer service professional with 6 years of experience handling voice and chat support for a telecom process, 
including 2 years as a team lead. Focused on maintaining a high customer satisfaction score while coaching 
associates on resolution quality and de-escalation. 
Core Skills 
Technical: CRM/ticketing tools (Zendesk, Freshdesk) • Voice & chat support platforms • Basic reporting (Excel) 
Additional: Conflict resolution • Team coordination • Coaching & feedback • Active listening 
Professional Experience 
Team Lead — Customer Support — ConnectSphere BPO, Kozhikode 
Sep 2023 – Present 
• Lead a team of 12 associates on a telecom voice support process 
• Maintained team CSAT score above 92% for 6 consecutive months 
• Handle escalated calls and coach associates on resolution quality 
• Redesigned the team's shift-handover checklist, cutting missed follow-ups by 40% 
Senior Associate — Customer Support — ConnectSphere BPO, Kozhikode 
Aug 2021 – Aug 2023 
• Handled 60–70 inbound calls per day resolving billing and service issues 
• Recognized as Top Performer for Q3 2022 out of a team of 45 
• Trained 8 new hires during their first month on the floor 
Associate — Customer Support — ConnectSphere BPO, Kozhikode 
Jul 2019 – Jul 2021 
• Resolved first-contact billing and service queries for a telecom client 
• Consistently met quality and adherence targets over 2 years 
Key Achievements 
• Reduced average call handling time by 15% without a drop in CSAT score 
• Nominated for the company-wide 'Voice of the Customer' award, 2023 
Education 
B.Com — University of Calicut (2016 – 2019), 68% 
Certifications 
• Voice & Accent Training Certificate (2019) 
• Customer Service Excellence Workshop, internal (2022) 

Languages 
English (fluent)  •  Malayalam (native)  •  Hindi (working proficiency) 
Additional Information 
• Volunteer coordinator for the company's annual community outreach drive
